description: This Swift source file defines a class 'CanvasSchemeHandler' that implements a custom URL scheme handler for WKWebView. It manages serving local files from a session-specific directory, handling requests, resolving paths, and serving appropriate responses including error handling and fallback pages.

classes.name: CanvasSchemeHandler
classes.description: A URL scheme handler for WKWebView that serves local files from a session-specific directory, with support for indexing, security checks, and error handling.

methods.name: webView(_:start:)
methods.description: Handles the start of a URL scheme task, serving the appropriate response data or error.

methods.name: webView(_:stop:)
methods.description: No-op method to handle stopping a URL scheme task.

methods.name: response(for:)
methods.description: Generates a CanvasResponse for a given URL, serving file data or error pages based on request validity.

methods.name: resolveFileURL(sessionRoot:requestPath:)
methods.description: Resolves the file URL based on the session root and the request path, handling directory indexes and path normalization.

methods.name: resolveIndex(in:)
methods.description: Returns the URL of the index file ('index.html' or 'index.htm') in a directory if it exists.

methods.name: isFileURL(_:withinDirectory:)
methods.description: Checks if a given file URL is within the specified directory boundary for security.

methods.name: html(_:title:)
methods.description: Generates a simple HTML response with the provided body and optional title.

methods.name: welcomePage(sessionRoot:)
methods.description: Creates a welcome HTML page instructing to create an index.html in the session root.

methods.name: scaffoldPage(sessionRoot:)
methods.description: Provides a scaffold page when no index.html exists, either a bundled resource or a fallback welcome page.

methods.name: loadBundledResourceData(relativePath:)
methods.description: Loads resource data bundled in the app given a relative path.

methods.name: textEncodingName(forMimeType:)
methods.description: Determines the text encoding name based on the MIME type.
